cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.

mechanism: A repeatedly grants permission for packing decisions while reserving another approval that postpones a visitor's departure.
confusable: High status must cause the delay, not merely precede an ordinary offer of jam.
comparison: Luggage capacity and carrying weight contrast with the other alternative's appearance inspection.
seedUse: Canonical D02-b supplies suitcase departure and a helpful packing pretext; S01-b supplies granting permission over someone else's independent action.
